about: Sam's verdict on open-asks sheet 39, card 2 ('Give OSHA one name as issuer in the CER?'): 'name'. The CER named OSHA three ways across 13 entries; the name on 9 of them becomes the one name. Five curator rows carry another spelling and change by guarded update (replaces names each live value and reviewer): the two Agriculture issuing_agency_override rows (2026-07-08) and the three unclassified triage issuing_agency_assignment rows that set U.S. Department of Labor on the OSHA 10 Card and OSHA 30 Card (2026-07-07). kb/_apply_credential_review.py and kb/_fold_unclassified.py only ever add an issuer, so the same pull request edits kb/credentials.json (the four entries' first record, and on the OSHA 10-hour Construction Training Course, OSHA as issuer with CTCNC as trainer, per Sam's rule that the trainer is not the issuer) and kb/unclassified_assignments.json to match; these rows keep the nightly sync from adding the old name back.
